result.text: Demonstrated a significant reduction in decline of FVC with nerandomilast vs placebo; adjusted mean difference versus placebo in FVC at Week 12 was 102 mL (non-AF group) and 80.4 mL (AF group)

citations.quote: Each study demonstrated significant reductions in decline of forced vital capacity (FVC) in adults with IPF with nerandomilast treatment compared to placebo.

This decrease in nerandomilast exposure with concomitant pirfenidone may partially explain the lower efficacy observed in subjects on baseline antifibrotic treatment compared to those not on antifibrotics (adjusted mean difference versus placebo [95% CI] in FVC at Week 12 was 102 [25.0, 178] mL and 80.4 [20.9, 140] mL for the non-AF and AF groups, respectively).

target_moa.text: Oral inhibitor of phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4) with at least nine-fold preferential inhibition of the PDE4B isoenzyme; PDE4B inhibition raises intracellular cAMP and reduces pro-fibrotic growth factors and inflammatory cytokines, exerting antifibrotic and immunomodulatory effects

citations.quote: Nerandomilast is an inhibitor of phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4) with at least nine-fold preferential inhibition of the PDE4B isoenzyme over PDE4A, C and D based on in vitro data.

Nerandomilast exerts both antifibrotic and immunomodulatory effects as PDE4B inhibition elevates intracellular cAMP levels and reduces the expression of pro-fibrotic growth factors and inflammatory cytokines, which are overexpressed in IPF
an oral small molecule inhibitor of phosphodiesterase isoenzyme 4B (PDE4B), for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF)

Diarrhea was the most frequent adverse reaction leading to discontinuation (6% at 18 mg, 2% at 9 mg).
